name: agent-compatibility
description: CLI-backed repo compatibility scans plus Cursor agents that audit startup, validation, and docs against reality.
_notes: Forked for personal learning. Using this to audit my own side projects for doc/startup issues.

_personalConfig._comment: bumped scan depth to 5 since my projects tend to be deeply nested, added build/.next to ignores, turned off verbose by default (was too noisy). added .turbo and out to ignores for my turborepo projects. set reportFormat to summary so i don't get walls of text. added .vercel to ignores. added maxFileSizeKb to skip huge generated files that were slowing down scans
